$comment: Hand-authored evaluation for the automation-depth backlog (scripts/truth/product-readiness-backlog.mjs). One entry per delivery family, matched on the start of fulfilment.deliveryMode in dws10.com/config/products.json. 'automated' lists steps running in code today, with evidence. 'humanSteps' stay managed. 'volumeTrigger.threshold' is null until the HIC sets it: no order-volume data exists yet to justify a number. Evaluated 2026-09-27 by Claude Code on branch claude/ecstatic-johnson-nd6uha.

sharedAutomation.step: Runbook step 1 — order intake with authoritative catalogue price
Durable fulfilment event and operations notification
Runbook steps 2 and 5 — buyer receives owner, acknowledgement SLA, acceptance outcomes and exclusions on payment
Runbook step 4 prepared — owning team receives delivery mode, runbook link and acceptance checklist
